title: TwinAttestation
description: A single foreign attestation admitted into a MultiversealTwin, bound-at-ingest against a context reference. Realizes the Powell-Stetson rule: an imported claim (object beam o) is admissible ONLY as t = bind(o, r_c) with a provenance envelope; a bare unbound score is never summed into reputation. The context reference r_c is VRF-derived (see TwinRecord.mintAnchor). Reconcilability is manufactured at ingest, not deferred. This is the holographic form of the capture-time receipt: purpose/authorization are bound to the event before it enters the reputation ledger.

id.description: Stable URN for this bound attestation.

capturedAt.description: Ingest time (record-beam time) — when binding occurred.

twinRef.description: The twin this attestation is bundled into.

contextRef.description: The context reference r_c this claim was bound against (VRF-derived; see TwinRecord.mintAnchor).

contextId.description: The federation context/neighbourhood this binding is for.

referenceId.description: Identifier of the VRF-derived reference r_c used to bind.

boundVector.description: The bound record t = bind(o, r_c). The bare object o is NEVER stored here; only its binding against the reference.

encoding.description: Substrate: Holographic Reduced Representation / Vector-Symbolic Algebra over C^D. Phase carries provenance; magnitude carries raw score.

digest.description: Content digest of the bound vector (the stored, opaque-without-reference record).

dimension.description: D of the twin space (must match the twin's dimension).

envelope.description: Provenance envelope pi = (src, method, tau, w). Bound with the claim so purpose/authorization are sealed at capture, not inferred later.

src.description: Source of the attestation (issuing neighbourhood / authority).

issuedAt.description: tau: source time of the claim.

evidenceRefs.description: Works-receipts on the reasoning-evidence fabric substantiating the claim.

authorization.description: The purpose/consent bit — provably unrecoverable from the signal, so it must be bound here at ingest (reidentification-economy §A.5).

declaredPurpose.description: The purpose under which this claim was captured/admitted.

authorizationProof.description: Proof of authorization for that purpose.

grounding.description: Coherence-length gate. If the context/temporal distance delta(o, r_c) exceeds the trust reference's coherence length L_c, the import is ungroundable — retained as inert evidence, never summed.

state.description: coherent = groundable and summable into reputation; decohered = inert evidence only.

coherenceLength.description: L_c ~= c/Delta-nu, the derived trust horizon (replaces an arbitrary reputation-decay constant).

distance.description: delta(o, r_c) — context/temporal distance from the reference.
